Hi team,

We were asked by AcmeCloud to do a joint booth at the SaaS Growth Summit (May 27-29). BrightStage sent a preliminary estimate for a 10x20 inline booth plus branding and AV; attached (brightstage_estimate_v3.xlsx). Rough total is $32,800 (venue fee deposit + booth build + AV + logistics).

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SaaS Growth Summit — preliminary budget ask

Thanks Lauren — quick notes:

1) Any single-event spend above $25,000 requires documented manager approval + PO for vendor payment. Rafael, can you confirm you’re comfortable with this range or want to escalate to CFO?
2) Please confirm vendor billing terms (deposit %, net30, credit card ok). If BrightStage needs >50% deposit we'll need to either prepay via card (preferred) or create a PO and wire.
3) Cost center: MK-OPS-410 is fine; for visibility mark Expense Tag = "Field-Events-Q2" and project = "SaaS-Growth-2026".
4) I'll create a draft PO once we have the final invoice. Include the signed MSA excerpt if available — I see you listed signed_msa_excerpt.pdf in attachments?

Next steps:
- Lauren: confirm final vendor estimate and payment terms; get AcmeCloud's share and whether they will reimburse/redress on our PO.
- Stephanie: share the promo budget (giveaways, collateral) so we can include in the PO or submit as separate expense.

I’ll queue PO creation for next week if we have the final invoice and Rafael’s confirmation.

Best,
Dev Patel
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
